name: Lek Mint
description: On-chain Bitcoin ecash mint. Unit: lek (difficulty-pegged).
description_long: Lek Mint issues ecash backed by on-chain Bitcoin deposits only — there is no Lightning. Minting (deposits) and melting (withdrawals to a BTC address) happen on the Lek Mint website. External Cashu wallets can hold, send, receive, and swap lek tokens. Note: lek is difficulty-pegged via epochs — after an epoch rate change, older tokens are worth MORE than their face value. Face-value swaps of old tokens are accepted; the appreciation is escrowed for the sender and credited when the original token is pasted into the Lek Mint website wallet.
